tool.name: 3D Trees LAS to 3D Tiles Converter
tool.description: Convert LAS/LAZ point cloud files to Cesium 3D Tiles with interactive viewer
tool.command:
## Set up output directory structure mkdir -p output_dir &&
## Run the converter gocesiumtiler file --out output_dir/tileset #if str($crs_in).strip() --crs '$crs_in' #end if --resolution '$resolution' --depth '$depth' --min-points-per-tile '$min_points_per_tile' '$input' &&
## Copy tileset.json to output cp output_dir/tileset/tileset.json tileset.json

param.name: input
param.label: Point Cloud Dataset
param.help: LAS point cloud file to convert (LAZ not yet supported)

param.name: crs_in
param.label: Input CRS (EPSG code)
param.help: Override auto-detected CRS. Format: EPSG:#### or just ####. Leave empty for auto-detection from LAS metadata.

validator.message: Must be EPSG code (e.g., EPSG:32632 or 32632)

param.name: resolution
param.label: Grid Resolution (meters)
param.help: Spatial sampling grid cell size. Lower=finer detail (5-10 for urban), higher=faster processing (50-100 for terrain)

param.name: depth
param.label: Tree Depth
param.help: Maximum octree subdivision levels. More=smoother zoom (12-15), less=faster conversion (6-8)

param.name: min_points_per_tile
param.label: Minimum Points per Tile
param.help: Minimum points before creating tile. Fewer=smoother LOD (1000-3000), more=fewer files (8000-15000)

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool converts LAS point cloud files to Cesium 3D Tiles format using gocesiumtiler v2.0.1, creating an interactive web-based viewer optimized for large point cloud datasets.
The tool generates:
1. **3D Tiles** - Industry-standard Cesium 3D Tiles v1.1 (GLB format) for efficient streaming 2. **Interactive Web Viewer** - Standalone HTML page with CesiumJS for browsing 3. **Tileset Metadata** - JSON file describing the tile hierarchy
**Performance: 5M+ points/second**
-----
**Input Requirements**
- **Format**: LAS files only (LAZ compressed format not yet supported) - **CRS**: Automatic detection from LAS metadata (GeoTIFF keys, WKT, PROJ strings) - **Size**: Optimized for large datasets (gigabytes+)
-----
**Parameters**
**Input CRS (optional)** Override auto-detected coordinate system. Use EPSG code format (e.g., "EPSG:32632" or "32632"). Leave empty for automatic detection from LAS file metadata.
**Grid Resolution (meters)** Controls spatial sampling density. Points aren't deleted randomly - space is divided into a 3D grid, keeping the point closest to each cell center at each detail level.
- **Lower (5-10)**: Urban areas, architectural models, fine detail preservation - **Default (20)**: Balanced quality for most datasets - **Higher (50-100)**: Large terrain, forests, quick preview conversions
**Tree Depth** Maximum octree subdivision levels for progressive detail loading.
- **Less (6-8)**: Small datasets, faster conversion, fewer tiles - **Default (10)**: Balanced for most use cases - **More (12-15)**: Very large datasets, smoother zoom transitions
**Minimum Points per Tile** Threshold for tile creation affects LOD quality and file count.
- **Fewer (1000-3000)**: Smoother level-of-detail transitions, more tiles - **Default (5000)**: Balanced performance - **More (8000-15000)**: Fewer HTTP requests, faster initial load
-----
**Common Use Case Presets**
.. class:: infomark
**Default (balanced)** Resolution: 20m | Depth: 10 | Min Points: 5000 Good for most datasets, balanced quality and performance
**Fast preview** Resolution: 50m | Depth: 8 | Min Points: 10000 Quick conversion for testing, lower quality
**High quality urban** Resolution: 5m | Depth: 12 | Min Points: 1000 Architectural models, detailed city scans
**Large terrain** Resolution: 20m | Depth: 12 | Min Points: 5000 Forests, landscapes, large study areas
-----
**Output**
- **Tileset Metadata** (JSON): Main tileset.json file describing tile hierarchy and structure - **Tile Files**: Additional GLB format tiles (discovered as extra datasets)
**Note**: The tileset output can be downloaded and hosted on a web server for visualization with CesiumJS or other 3D Tiles viewers.
-----
**Technical Details**
- **Engine**: gocesiumtiler v2.0.1 - **3D Tiles**: Version 1.1 GLB format - **CRS Support**: Universal via PROJ 9.5.0 - **Performance**: 5M+ points/second processing speed
